nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner (Owned.owner).
Pending owner address during two-step ownership transfer (Owned.newOwner).
Mapping(address => uint) holding token balances of every holder.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of ERC20 allowances.
Total token supply stored in the contract, set in the constructor.
Public token symbol string (ERIC).
Public token name string (ERICOIN).
Public token decimals value (6).
SafeMath.safeAdd: adds two uints and requires no overflow.
SafeMath.safeSub: subtracts two uints and requires no underflow.
SafeMath.safeMul: multiplies two uints and requires no overflow.
SafeMath.safeDiv: divides two uints and requires a non-zero divisor.
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
owner-only function that stages newOwner for the ownership handover.
Completes ownership transfer if msg.sender == newOwner and clears newOwner.
EriCoin constructor that sets metadata, total supply and pre-mints all tokens to a fixed address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances of address(0).
Returns the balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
ERC20 transfer: moves tokens from msg.sender to the receiver using safeSub/safeAdd.
ERC20 approve: sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens.
ERC20 transferFrom: moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' and reduces the caller allowance.
Returns the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Approves a spender and then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract in the same transaction.
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts, rejecting ETH.
owner-only rescue function that calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 token address.
External caller address (msg.sender), attacker controllable.
Unsigned addition c = a + b followed by overflow guard require(c >= a).
Unsigned subtraction c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
Unsigned multiplication c = a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Unsigned division c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed before state is finalised, enabling reentrancy.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an attacker-supplied token contract.
Balance mutation in transfer: balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(...) and balances[to] = safeAdd(...).
Balance and allowance mutation in transferFrom: balances[from], allowed[from][msg.sender] and balances[to].

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the caller the privileged owner.
transferOwnership is protected by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender to owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before the ownership handover completes.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debited balance key balances[msg.sender].
approve writes the caller-controlled key allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom consumes the allowance of msg.sender via allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the external callee.
Fallback function reverts unconditionally, so msg.sender cannot send ETH or trigger logic.
Parameter a of safeAdd feeds the addition computation.
Parameter b of safeAdd feeds the addition computation.
Parameter a of safeSub feeds the subtraction computation.
Parameter b of safeSub feeds the subtraction computation.
Parameter a of safeMul feeds the multiplication computation.
Parameter b of safeMul feeds the multiplication computation.
Parameter a of safeDiv feeds the division computation.
Parameter b of safeDiv feeds the division computation.
Operand a flows into the unchecked-style addition guarded only by require(c >= a).
Operand b flows into the addition guarded only by require(c >= a).
Minuend a flows into the subtraction guarded by require(b <= a).
Subtrahend b flows into the subtraction guarded by require(b <= a).
Operand a flows into the multiplication overflow check.
Operand b flows into the multiplication overflow check.
Dividend a flows into safeDiv.
Divisor b flows into safeDiv where require(b > 0) prevents division by zero.
_newOwner parameter is stored into newOwner.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
Recipient parameter 'to' is credited in transfer.
Token amount parameter is used in both safeSub and safeAdd calls of transfer.
spender indexes the nested allowance mapping in approve.
tokens value is written into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
'from' account is debited in transferFrom.
'to' account is credited in transferFrom.
tokens amount drives the balance and allowance reductions in transferFrom.
tokenOwner indexes the allowance mapping in allowance.
spender indexes the allowance mapping in allowance.
spender is approved and then called externally by approveAndCall.
tokens amount is written into allowed and forwarded to receiveApproval.
Arbitrary data is forwarded to the untrusted spender contract call.
tokenAddress is used to construct and call an arbitrary ERC20 interface.
tokens amount is forwarded to the external token transfer call.
safeAdd performs the guarded unsigned addition.
safeSub performs the guarded unsigned subtraction.
safeMul performs the guarded unsigned multiplication.
safeDiv performs the guarded unsigned division.
transfer updates balances through safeSub and safeAdd arithmetic.
transferFrom updates balances and allowance through safeSub and safeAdd arithmetic.
The transfer balance mutation writes into the balances state mapping.
The transferFrom balance mutation writes into the balances state mapping.
The transferFrom allowance mutation writes into the allowed state mapping.
transfer calls safeSub to deduct from the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the receiver balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both the balance and the allowance deduction.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the receiver balance.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an attacker-supplied contract, handing control to the callee before returning.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to a caller-supplied token contract (owner-only, but arbitrary code execution).
Owned constructor writes msg.sender into the owner state variable.
transferOwnership stores the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads and then clears newOwner to address(0).
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the privileged owner slot.
EriCoin constructor sets the total supply.
EriCoin constructor pre-mints the whole supply into balances of a fixed address.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and receiver.
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes balances for the from and to accounts.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowed mapping of the caller.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed allowance mapping before the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token sends rescued tokens to the owner address.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a only exists to feed safeAdd arithmetic and has no independent identity.
Parameter b only exists to feed safeAdd arithmetic and has no independent identity.
Parameter a only exists to feed the safeSub subtraction.
Parameter b only exists to feed the safeSub subtraction.
Parameter a only exists to feed the safeMul multiplication.
Parameter b only exists to feed the safeMul multiplication.
Parameter a only exists to feed the safeDiv division.
Parameter b only exists to feed the safeDiv division and its zero check.
_newOwner is the sole input of transferOwnership and is immediately written to newOwner.
tokenOwner is only used as a lookup key in balanceOf.
Recipient address is used only within the transfer balance update.
tokens directly drives the safeSub/safeAdd balance mutation in transfer.
spender is only used as the allowance mapping key in approve.
tokens is only the value written to the allowance mapping in approve.
'from' is the debited account in the transferFrom balance mutation.
'to' is the credited account in the transferFrom balance mutation.
tokens drives both the balance and allowance arithmetic in transferFrom.
tokenOwner is only a lookup key in the allowance getter.
spender is only a lookup key in the allowance getter.
spender becomes the external contract address invoked by approveAndCall.
tokens is the allowance value written before the external callback.
data is arbitrary calldata forwarded verbatim to the untrusted spender.
tokenAddress is the target contract of the arbitrary external ERC20 call.
tokens is the amount argument forwarded to the external transfer call.
